data.import_statistics: Import historical readings as long-term statistics

backfill_statistics.name: Backfill long-term statistics
backfill_statistics.description: Re-imports meter readings into long-term statistics at the supplier's reported timestamps. When 'days' is set, the integration fetches that many days of fresh data from the supplier (up to ~5 years). When 'days' is omitted, it replays the most recently cached readings (up to 48 hours). Use after deleting bad statistics, or to bootstrap a long history after the integration was reinstalled.

meter_number.name: Meter number
meter_number.description: Optional. If set, only backfills the matching configured meter. Omit to backfill all configured meters.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of days of history to fetch from the supplier (1-1825). Omit to replay only the most recent cached readings (up to 48 h).

force_full.name: Force full
force_full.description: Re-import every fetched reading, including already-imported buckets. The cumulative sum continues from the last stored point before the imported window. Default: off.
